title: block_unauthenticated_api_access
description: Protected API endpoints must return 401 without session.

title: block_csrf_on_state_changing_routes
description: POST /profile/set without CSRF token must return 419.

title: reject_webhook_without_token
description: POST /webhooks/asaas without asaas-access-token must not process payment (401 in prod, verify behavior in local).

title: idor_charge_nonexistent_id
description: GET /api/charges/999999999 must return 404, not leak data.

title: idor_package_nonexistent_id
description: GET /api/packages/999999999 must return 404.

title: idor_notification_foreign_id
description: POST /api/notifications/1/read for another user must return 403 or 404.

title: sql_injection_search_charges
description: GET /api/charges?search=' OR 1=1-- must not return 500 or expose SQL errors.

title: sql_injection_user_search
description: GET /api/users/search?term='; DROP TABLE users;-- must return safe response (422/200), never 500.

title: block_open_redirect_external
description: GET /login?redirect=https://evil.com must not set external redirect in session.

title: security_headers_present
description: Responses should include X-Frame-Options or similar protective headers.

title: rate_limit_login_bruteforce
description: After 6 failed logins, must receive 429 Too Many Requests.

title: mass_assignment_user_role_blocked
description: Morador cannot escalate to Síndico via API user update.

title: idor_marketplace_nonexistent
description: GET /api/marketplace/999999999 must return 404.

title: block_unauthenticated_panic
description: GET /panic/check without auth must redirect or return 401/302.

title: sensitive_api_no_cache_headers
description: GET /api/user must not expose session in public cache headers.

title: path_traversal_dev_docs
description: GET /dev/docs/../../../etc/passwd must return 404.

title: http_method_override_blocked
description: DELETE on read-only endpoint must return 405 or 403.

title: idor_reservation_nonexistent
description: GET /api/reservations/999999999 must return 404.

title: xss_reflection_search_safe
description: Search with <script>alert(1)</script> must not reflect unescaped in JSON error.

title: tenant_isolation_charges_list
description: Authenticated syndic charges list must only return own condominium data.
